established: Full do-collision body attempts moving-path advancement before lifetime decrement. A failed moving-path result ends through the damage handler without decrementing the frame. Otherwise it decrements once before contact selection, and frame<=0 ends before contacts. A stationary60-frame cloud therefore has59 possible contact passes, followed by its ending callback.

NOCOLLIDE returns after lifetime decrement. Collision flags1or4 remove; barrier mode, not-yet-activated frame or zero flags skip contact. Missing route callback removes. Active saved steps use one candidate finder; first candidate immediately dispatches one hit handler. No candidate plus wallbit4 dispatches an ending handler and returns removal2.

Trail do2 invokes its creator before this entire body (existing complete trail proof). Thus a cloud may be created from the previous path-change flag before the next move, including the parent final update; this is not an every-cell emission loop.
limits: World/path advancement, room masks, saved steps, route callback, owner, candidate finder and final hit/removal handler are declared services. These5120 cases cover valid missile/row/path/room with one saved step; null/invalid input, full path computation, actual finder spatial/ordering, outer event/removal and modern executable equivalence remain separate.

Combined source proofs establish packet/factory/router/update contracts; no Poison Javelin handler is enabled by this fixture. Native trail geometry, do-handler integration, start/release resources, item events and actual input/reload remain to implement.
